limits_and_scope: Gold source ranges and semantic expectations were recorded while generating neutral source, independently of product parsing and retrieval.
Range completeness is not a score for model answers, autonomous investigation, compiler acceptance, or runtime effects.
Question mode requests at most three oracle-known missing ranges on the first reply, then emits a deliberately incomplete synthetic summary.
Closure mode requests at most three currently missing oracle ranges on each reply until full current evidence or the existing six-request/180-second budget is reached.

Historical cumulative coverage is separated from current transmitted pages and current full-text memory with verified original request binding. A locator or candidate note does not count as retransmitted source.
The 13KB single-line recovery probe explicitly uses a 20KB tool limit. The default 12KB read budget remains unchanged and cannot supply this whole line.
All large sources and full wire payloads remain outside Git. Only question-critical physical ranges must be supplied, not irrelevant 100k+ lines.
Two question repeats, one closure attempt, and one cold index observation per version/scale are insufficient to claim a statistical speed improvement.
Synthetic response generation latency excludes external provider latency. PARTIAL synthetic answers are expected and are not quality passes.
Ordinary nested COPY and a separate nonnested COPY REPLACING are source-analysis fixtures; no target dialect compiler was used.
Version-1 source bytes were retained unchanged. Version-2 corrects only the neutral manual placeholder width from four to six characters.
